recipe.title: Chickpea and tuna salad with mustard dressing
steps: Drain the tuna and the chickpeas. Rinse the chickpeas.
Halve the cherry tomatoes, slice the spring onion and tear the lettuce.
Mix mustard, lemon juice and pepper into a dressing. Keep it in a small jar.
Store tuna, chickpeas and vegetables in 5 boxes. Add the dressing at work.
Eat cold, or warm the chickpeas and tuna in the microwave for 1 minute and add the lettuce after.
